title.zh: OpenAI Promises to Foot AI’s Power Bill After Voter Revolt. Who Enforces It?
title.en: OpenAI Promises to Foot AI’s Power Bill After Voter Revolt. Who Enforces It?

current_state.zh: OpenAI announced a National Community Compact pledging to pay the full electricity and grid costs of future AI campuses it owns and operates, disclose site-level energy and water use, and limit secrecy agreements with officials, alongside a policy blueprint urging lawmakers to impose similar enforceable rules industry-wide.
